class.name: InputAction
class.brief_description: One action of the [InputMap] as a resource: its name, deadzone and events.
class.description: An [InputAction] describes one action of the [InputMap] ([code]"jump"[/code], [code]"ui_accept"[/code], ...) with its [member action] name, its [member deadzone] and its [member events]. The layers of the [InputMap] are [InputActions] of [InputAction]s: [method InputMap.get_input_action] returns the action of the [InputMap] itself (changing it changes the [InputMap]), and [method InputMap.set_input_action] puts one into the [InputMap]. A set of actions is an [InputActions]. [InputMapSettingsServer] stores the player's bindings as [InputActions]. The events are available in two forms. [member events] is the list of [InputEvent]s for scripts and the Inspector. [member bindings] is the same list as readable text that is stored in files, so the resource survives JSON, INI, CSV and [code].tres[/code]. The events are separated by [code]"; "[/code], for example [code]Key:Ctrl+S; JoypadButton:A[/code]. A joypad event that is bound to one pad ends with [code]@[/code] and the device id, for example [code]JoypadButton:A@1[/code]. Each event has the text form [code]Type:Value[/code]: - [code]Key:Ctrl+S[/code], [code]PhysicalKey:W[/code] and [code]KeyLabel:Shift+A[/code]: an [InputEventKey] matched by [member InputEventKey.keycode], [member InputEventKey.physical_keycode] or [member InputEventKey.key_label]. The modifiers are [code]Ctrl[/code], [code]Alt[/code], [code]Shift[/code], [code]Meta[/code] and [code]CmdOrCtrl[/code] ([member InputEventWithModifiers.command_or_control_autoremap]: Command on macOS, Ctrl on the other platforms). The key names are those of [method OS.get_keycode_string]; unknown codes are written as [code]#[/code] and the number. - [code]MouseButton:Left[/code], [code]MouseButton:Ctrl+WheelUp[/code]: an [InputEventMouseButton]. The buttons are [code]Left[/code], [code]Right[/code], [code]Middle[/code], [code]WheelUp[/code], [code]WheelDown[/code], [code]WheelLeft[/code], [code]WheelRight[/code], [code]Extra1[/code] and [code]Extra2[/code]. - [code]JoypadButton:A[/code]: an [InputEventJoypadButton] with the names of [enum JoyButton] in PascalCase ([code]LeftShoulder[/code], [code]DPadUp[/code], ...) or the button index. - [code]JoypadMotion:LeftX+[/code]: an [InputEventJoypadMotion] with the axis ([code]LeftX[/code], [code]LeftY[/code], [code]RightX[/code], [code]RightY[/code], [code]TriggerLeft[/code], [code]TriggerRight[/code] or the axis index) and the direction ([code]+[/code] or [code]-[/code]). Event types without a text form (touch, MIDI, ...) are kept in [member events] but are not part of [member bindings]. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var action = InputAction.new() action.action = &"jump" action.deadzone = 0.3 action.bindings = "Key:Space; JoypadButton:A" InputMap.set_input_action(action) [/gdscript] [csharp] var action = new InputAction(); action.Action = "jump"; action.Deadzone = 0.3f; action.Bindings = "Key:Space; JoypadButton:A"; InputMap.Singleton.SetInputAction(action); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: add_event
method.description: Adds [param event] to [member events]. Does nothing if the action already has the event (see [method has_event]).

method.name: clear_events
method.description: Removes all events from the action.

method.name: event_to_text
method.description: Returns the text form of [param event] (see the class description), or an empty [String] for event types that have none (touch, MIDI, ...). A key the player presses has all three codes; it is written as [code]PhysicalKey[/code], so the binding stays on the same key position on every keyboard layout. A modifier key on its own (such as [code]PhysicalKey:Shift[/code]) is written without modifiers. The device of the event is not part of the text.

method.name: get_device_events
method.description: Returns the events of [param device] in the order of [member events]. For example [constant INPUT_DEVICE_KEYBOARD] returns all keys of the action.

method.name: get_event_count
method.description: Returns the number of events of the action.

method.name: get_event_device
method.description: Returns the device that [param event] belongs to: [constant INPUT_DEVICE_KEYBOARD] for an [InputEventKey], [constant INPUT_DEVICE_MOUSE] for an [InputEventMouseButton], [constant INPUT_DEVICE_GAMEPAD] for an [InputEventJoypadButton] or [InputEventJoypadMotion], and [constant INPUT_DEVICE_MAX] for event types that can't be bound.

method.name: has_event
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the action has [param event] itself or an event that matches it exactly (see [method InputEvent.is_match] with [code]exact_match[/code] set to [code]true[/code]).

method.name: remove_event
method.description: Removes [param event] or the first event that matches it exactly (see [method has_event]) from the action. Returns [code]true[/code] if an event was removed, [code]false[/code] if the action has no such event.

method.name: text_to_event
method.description: Returns a new event of the text form [param text] (see the class description), or [code]null[/code] if the text is not valid. Its [member InputEvent.device] is [code]-1[/code] (all devices). [code]CmdOrCtrl[/code] is resolved here: the event uses [member InputEventWithModifiers.command_or_control_autoremap].

members.member: The name of the action in the [InputMap], for example [code]&"jump"[/code]. The property is not called [code]name[/code], because [member Resource.resource_name] already uses that name.

The events in text form, separated by [code]"; "[/code], for example [code]"Key:Ctrl+S; JoypadButton:A"[/code] (see the class description). This is the stored form of [member events]: setting it replaces all events, and the getter returns the events that have a text form. Texts that are not valid are skipped with a warning.
The deadzone of the action, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code] (see [method InputMap.action_set_deadzone]).
The events that trigger the action. This list is shown in the Inspector; it is not stored in files, [member bindings] is. Event types without a text form (touch, MIDI, ...) are only kept here.

constants.constant: A mouse button or the mouse wheel ([InputEventMouseButton]).
The number of devices; also returned by [method get_event_device] for events that can't be bound.
